## Wave 5 Summary

This wave executes the transit/GGE + flat-band + LRD carry-forward block from S100b. The centerpiece is the S-1 adjudicated, tuple-pinned promotion of the fold impulsive-window |β_pivot|² (W5-1) — NOT a silent promotion of the W5-1 payload 3.045e-07, but a re-evaluation of the validated box+delta recipe at the BINDING 4-component convention tuple (Z-PUMP weights / branch-(c) barrier / fold-conformal clock / IMPULSIVE-TRANSIT-WINDOW ladder stage), expected O(2.1e-6) in v-quanta — followed by its campaign-emergent companion, the B1 stage-split ladder composition with the same-convention F_amp-slot cross-check (W5-2, hard dependency on W5-1). The tricritical-adjacency follow-up (W5-3) classifies the fold's diagnostic exponent triple against the kitaev-litrev V.4 template under the verbatim scoping "first-order, tricritical-ADJACENT only". The flat-band pair lands the S-2-enriched B2 isotropy-breaking discriminator under the BINDING 0.6/0.4 dual-prior (W5-4) and the AF1 Mode-A absolute R^BdG reproduction (W5-5). The LRD per-z selection re-verification (W5-6) replaces the flat bound-form floor with the per-z selection function under a pre-registered data-availability fallback chain. Substrate framing for the wave: the supersonic transit (Mach 13.75) deposits pairs by WHERE the spectral-excursion window reaches — range-controlled, Rao class (S100b W5-2 PASS) — and |β_pivot|² IS the per-mode window deposit price in the substrate's own conformal clock; the B2 quadruplet IS the sole moving carrier of band geometry on the U(2)-invariant base.

```yaml
substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    --- Chain A: mu_pivot^2 sign row ---
    Definition 1: mu_pivot^2 := k_pivot^2 - V_box^(c)
                  [interior dispersion of the box stage: v'' + mu^2 v = 0 inside
                   the window; the sin-branch closed form is valid iff mu^2 > 0]
    Definition 2: k_pivot = 14.311092688448717 M_KK
                  [fold normalization, s77_n_pivot_map.npz key k_pivot_com_fold;
                   NEVER the mixed-convention 4.30e-57]
    Definition 3: V_box^(c) = 2.764080442498705 M_KK^2
                  [branch-(c) stored s64 zpp_over_z window mean; s100b npz key
                   zppz_stored_fold_units = V_box_branch_c]
    Substitute:   mu_pivot^2 = (14.311092688448717)^2 - 2.764080442498705
    Simplify:     = 204.80737393737033 - 2.764080442498705
                  = 202.04329349487162 M_KK^2
    Direction:    202.043 > 0  =>  oscillatory (sin-branch) interior;
                  margin k_pivot^2 / V_box^(c) = 74.1x
    Conclusion:   mu_pivot^2 > 0 sign row predicted PASS with 74x margin;
                  the sin-branch closed form remains valid at the adjudicated
                  tuple (synthesis §II.5(i): "mu^2(c) = 202.04 > 0, margin 74x,
                  sin-branch intact").
    --- Chain B: Born-limit DIAGNOSTIC band (reported, never gated) ---
    Definition 1: |beta|^2_Born = (Omega_bar_z * Delta_eta)^2 with
                  Omega_bar_z = (|Omega_z_on| + |Omega_z_off|)/2 = 1.2878825015846113 M_KK
    Substitute:   (1.2878825015846113 * 1.13014059e-3)^2 = (1.4555e-3)^2 = 2.1184e-6;
                  exact per-edge weights + interior phase give the stored anchor
                  beta2_zpump_weights = 2.1195270585018085e-06
    Simplify:     branch-(c) correction <= +1.0% (the (b)<->(c) fork at Omega_z is
                  relatively weaker than at Omega_psi since the box fraction is
                  x6.96 weaker) => upper edge 2.140e-6
    Canonical form: Born-limit band [2.119, 2.140]e-6
    Direction:    the canonical value is COMPUTED in-gate from the pinned
                  channels; the band is a sanity diagnostic ONLY
    Conclusion:   report distance of the computed value to the band; NO gating
                  on band membership (pre-registered: "the value is an output,
                  not a target").

# ---- Verdict rubric ----
PASS_meaning: "The validated recipe survives the tuple re-pin: the canonical v-quanta window deposit price beta2_pivot_box_delta (expected O(2.1e-6)) is on the books with the full 4-component tuple + the sqrtA_recipe diagnostic; the x6.96 silent-inheritance hazard is permanently closed; W5-2 unblocks; mack Step-3 row routes to Wave 6."
FAIL_meaning: "A recipe-internal criterion breaks at the new tuple (unitarity breach / var_Nseg >= 2 / mu^2 <= 0) or the publication pipeline breaks round-trip — the adjudicated tuple does NOT carry the validated recipe; promotion does NOT execute; the S-1 adjudication's tuple derivation is re-opened as a cross-session contradiction (Investigating-Workshops Q1); W5-2 mechanically closes."
INFO_meaning: "Recipe-internal criteria hold and the value is computed/reported, but write-order Steps 1-2 cannot complete in-gate for a structural reason (e.g. sub-keying ambiguity per math-scripts.md in-session-vs-carry-forward decision rule); promotion routes to a 4-field CF; W5-2 may still proceed on the npz value with the non-promotion disclosed."
```

## §W5-2. S101-LADDER-COMPOSITION

Companion (S-1 campaign-emergent; transit synthesis §V.2, closeout §V.8 companion). B1 stage-split B1a·W·B1b + same-convention F_amp-slot cross-check. CONSUMES W5-1 (hard dependency). The PASS band delegated to the planner ("a band of O(10⁻²) RATIO is the natural pre-registration; planner pins the final number") is FROZEN here at 1.0e-2 with the derivation in the chain.

```yaml
# ---- Identity ----
gate_id: "S101-LADDER-COMPOSITION"
schema_version: "R3"
trigger: "[VERIFY]"
classification: "PHONONIC"
agent_type: "transit-dynamics-theorist"
hypothesis: "Splitting the S79 B1 stage at the impulsive-window edges into B1a * W * B1b — with W the W5-1 window-stage SU(1,1) matrix at the adjudicated tuple — reproduces the unsplit B1 |beta|^2 within the per-boundary convention-coherence bound (first-order in the window amplitude), and the F_amp-slot consistency statement composes through B2 at the ladder level (coherent-phase-limit caveat per the S79 product rule)."

method:
  description: >
    (1) Build the window-stage SU(1,1) matrix W from W5-1's (alpha, beta)
    v-quanta output at the adjudicated tuple (same convention for ALL factors:
    Z-PUMP weights, v-quanta normalization, fold-conformal clock — convention
    coherence per S-1 §II.3 corollary is the load-bearing pin; the window
    |beta|^2 is a ~10^3-deep cancellation residual, so per-boundary and
    per-stage coherence is what the composition tests).
    (2) Split B1 (pre-fold SS -> post-fold WKB; S79 P2-A anchor |beta_1|^2 ~
    4.3e4) at the window edges eta_window (s100b npz key) into B1a (pre-fold SS
    -> window-on edge) and B1b (window-off edge -> post-fold WKB), evaluated on
    the s64 MS channels with BD-in-out v-quanta matching at the split points.
    (3) Compose B1a * W * B1b in SU(1,1); verify unitarity of every factor and
    of the composition (<= 1e-10 ABS); compare |beta_composed|^2 to the unsplit
    |beta_B1|^2 evaluated on the SAME channels with the SAME conventions
    (the unsplit B1 is RE-EVALUATED in-script — never loaded from the S79
    anchor alone, which is the independent-target discipline; the S79 anchor
    4.3e4 serves as an OOM cross-check).
    (4) Carry the composition through B2 (S79 anchor |beta_2|^2 ~ 1.7e3 =
    npz key B2_ladder_anchor) to state the F_amp-slot consistency claim at the
    ladder level: does the window-stage insertion alter the UNIFIED-AS-79
    F_amp slot occupancy (F_amp^sc = 47.92, 3PI closure, S82 W3-5 canonical;
    slot-adjusted 0.3885 for k_a2)? Expected NO by the e-fold-span argument
    (window DeltaN = 1.10e-3 e-folds). If the statement requires relative
    phases between the B-stages that the S79 anchors (magnitudes only) do not
    carry, the coherent-phase caveat FIRES and the gate emits INFO with the
    caveat documented (binding pre-registration; the S79 product rule
    F_amp x S_IC is valid only in the coherent-phase limit).
```

## §W5-6. S101-LRD-SELECTION-REVERIFY

CF-S101-LRD-SELECTION-REVERIFY (closeout §V.12; `session-100b-w7-workingpaper.md` CF block, W7-1 INFO routing). Replaces the flat bound-form floor with the per-z selection function + the explicit classic-cut sub-sample integer; re-verifies the count-form capture fraction non-circularly; re-folds W7-2 C2b and W7-3 A1/B1. The DATA-AVAILABILITY CONDITION is pre-registered as a 3-route fallback chain (BINDING requirement of this plan).

```yaml
# ---- Identity ----
gate_id: "S101-LRD-SELECTION-REVERIFY"
schema_version: "R3"
trigger: "[VERIFY]"
classification: "PHONONIC"                 # the re-fold targets are substrate-GGE-structure claims; the extraction step is a laboratory-IN pipeline refinement, tagged as such
agent_type: "little-red-dots-jwst-analyst"
hypothesis: "The per-z selection function S_i(z) + explicit classic-cut sub-sample integer, extracted from the Rinaldi+ arXiv 2604.07138 machine-readable/figure data, yields a refined per-z capture band CONTAINED in the bound-form band [0.25, 1.0] at all z in [3, 13], so the W7-2 C2b and W7-3 A1/B1 bound-form conclusions inherit unchanged under the re-fold."

method:
  description: >
    DATA-AVAILABILITY CONDITION (pre-registered NOW; the source quantities
    were figure-only at S100b):
    ROUTE 1 (primary): machine-readable data — check arXiv ancillary files
    for 2604.07138 + journal machine-readable tables at dispatch; if
    available, extract S_i(z) per z-bin + the classic-cut sub-sample integer
    directly.
    ROUTE 2 (fallback): in-gate digitization of the published selection-
    function figure from the pinned PDF (downloads/2604.07138.pdf, SHA
    e392aad4...); digitize S_i(z) at the npz z_grid bins; propagate a
    digitization uncertainty sigma_dig = +/-0.05 ABSOLUTE in capture-fraction
    units (conservative: 5% of the [0,1] axis range, above typical 1-3%
    plot-digitization repeatability) into the refined band edges — the
    containment test then runs on the WIDENED refined band
    [S_lo(z) - sigma_dig, S_hi(z) + sigma_dig] (widening can only make
    containment HARDER, so a Route-2 PASS is conservative).
    ROUTE 3 (neither accessible — no machine-readable data AND the PDF figure
    is not digitizable, e.g. raster too coarse to resolve the curve):
    INFO-by-design deferral — the gate closes INFO with extraction_status =
    'DATA-UNAVAILABLE'; bound-form conclusions stand unchanged; the CF
    re-queues with the availability condition. Route taken is DECLARED in the
    verdict value field (route=1|2|3).
    EXTRACTION + NON-CIRCULAR RE-VERIFICATION: compute the count-form capture
    fraction from the extracted INTEGER COUNTS (classic-cut sub-sample integer
    / inclusive parent count per z-bin) — never from the published <= 25%
    fraction itself (that is the non-circularity: the published floor
    S_capture_floor_LRD_classic = 0.25 is the canonical CROSS-CHECK target,
    not the input); verify consistency with the published floor.
    RE-FOLD: pass the refined per-z band through the UNCHANGED wrapper entry
    points of computations/_shared/s100b_selection_fold.py to re-fold
    (a) W7-2 C2b (s100b_w7_a2_heavy_seed_abundance.npz; note C2b was
    band-mode-B-insensitive at S100b — re-confirm) and (b) W7-3 A1/B1 axes
    (s100b_w7_structure_timing_two_axis.npz); record per-conjunct verdict
    stability (flip / no-flip / margin shift).
    MCP pre-compute audit: get_constant(S_capture_floor_LRD_classic) = 0.25
    (S100b canonical, Rinaldi provenance); search_knowledge('LRD selection
    function per-z'); confirm no prior per-z extraction gate.
  producing_script: "computations/session-101/s101_w5_6_lrd_selection_reverify.py"

# ---- PRDR Checklist (8 items) ----

# (1) operator
operator:
  type: "set (band containment) + conjunct-stability conjunction"
  form: >
    PASS iff [ refined per-z band subset of [0.25, 1.0] at ALL z in [3, 13] ]
    AND [ count-form capture fraction (from integer counts) consistent with
    the published floor ] — bound-form conclusions then inherit unchanged
    (containment => inheritance, chain below).
    INFO iff containment fails at some z BUT no W7-2 C2b / W7-3 A1/B1
    conjunct flips under the re-fold  OR  Route 3 fires (DATA-UNAVAILABLE
    deferral, pre-registered).
    FAIL iff ANY conjunct flips under the refined band.

# (2) strict_PASS_boundary
strict_PASS_boundary:
  value: "band edges [0.25, 1.0] (canonical S_capture_floor_LRD_classic to unity); containment at all z-bins in [3, 13]"
  direction: "subset-of (per-bin: S_lo(z) >= 0.25 AND S_hi(z) <= 1.0)"

# (3) boundary_reachable_analytically
boundary_reachable_analytically:
  bool: false
  proof_ref: "null — the band edges are the S100b canonical observational floor (S_capture_floor_LRD_classic = 0.25, triple-attested fetched text) + the unitarity ceiling 1.0; observational pins, not analytic derivations. The containment=>inheritance DIRECTION is analytic (chain below)."

# (4) reachable_rationals
reachable_rationals:
  includes_integer_mesh: true
  mesh_density: "z-bins from the npz z_grid over [3, 13]; the classic-cut sub-sample count is an INTEGER by construction (the explicit integer is itself a deliverable)"

# (5) machinery_pin_map
machinery_pin_map:
  N_eval: "all z-bins of the npz z_grid intersected with [3, 13]"
  L_max: "N/A — observational-pipeline extraction + re-fold"
  scan_range: "z in [3, 13] (binding)"
  step_size: "npz z_grid binning (as stored)"
  tolerance: "containment strict per bin; Route-2 widening sigma_dig = 0.05 ABS; count-form consistency vs published floor reported at the integers' own precision"
  scheme: "SELECTION-FOLD-PER-Z"
  convention: "BAND-CONTAINMENT"
  fallback_chain: "Route 1 machine-readable -> Route 2 in-gate digitization (sigma_dig 0.05 ABS, widened-band test) -> Route 3 INFO-by-design deferral; route DECLARED in verdict value field"
  wrapper: "computations/_shared/s100b_selection_fold.py — entry points UNCHANGED (binding)"
  refold_targets: "W7-2 C2b (a2-channel heavy-seed abundance; band-mode-B-insensitive at S100b, re-confirm) + W7-3 A1/B1 (structure-timing two-axis)"
  random_seed: "N/A — deterministic"
  GPU_path: "cpu-cap-OMP8 (table extraction + interval arithmetic)"

# (6) audit_discriminators
audit_discriminators:
  audit_sha256_inputs: ["script", "input-pin map (PDF SHA + 4 static SHAs)", "machinery_pin_map incl. fallback route taken"]
  content_sha256_inputs: ["script"]

# (7) substitution_chain — containment => inheritance direction (MANDATORY)
substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Definition 1: bound-form fold: every S100b W7 downstream comparison folded
                  through the flat band S in [0.25, 1.0]
                  [S100b-SELECTION-FUNCTION-FLOOR; canonical
                   S_capture_floor_LRD_classic = 0.25]
    Definition 2: refined fold: per-z band [S_lo(z), S_hi(z)] from the
                  extracted S_i(z) (Route-2: widened by sigma_dig)
    Substitute:   containment hypothesis:
                  [S_lo(z), S_hi(z)] subset of [0.25, 1.0] for all z in [3, 13]
    Simplify:     the wrapper folds any target quantity X through S by a
                  monotone map (multiply/divide by S per bin); the image of a
                  sub-interval under a monotone map is a sub-interval of the
                  image  =>  refined-band allowed interval of X subset of
                  bound-form allowed interval of X, per bin
    Canonical form: containment of bands  =>  containment of folded allowed
                  regions  =>  every bound-form PASS-region statement remains
                  valid (conclusions INHERIT unchanged)
    Direction:    a W7-2/W7-3 conjunct can flip ONLY if containment fails on
                  the side that conjunct leans on — hence the INFO/FAIL split
                  keys on the RE-FOLD outcome (flip / no-flip), not on
                  containment alone
    Conclusion:   PASS = containment at all z (inheritance automatic);
                  INFO = containment fails somewhere, no conjunct flips;
                  FAIL = any conjunct flips.

# (8) input_files
input_files:
  rinaldi_pdf:
    path: "downloads/2604.07138.pdf"
    sha256: "e392aad4125b18d6d7a08b0c822c2c11587d3487ca322334c58377de85c3f434"
    # matches the S100b canonical-constants provenance pin (PDF SHA e392aad4125b18d6...)
  selection_floor_npz:

    sha256: "0dffa0c3f72ca4b12b4a155b515faf5c247275d97ce8f2955d44cc396a2fea0e"
    # consumed keys: z_grid, S_band_lo/hi (bound-form baseline), counts_*, zbin_lo/hi, extraction_status
  selection_fold_wrapper:

    sha256: "abd5dea36ea98908275916f559444d9a3ee7fc579112391571fc60f58c3ccb4b"
    # entry points UNCHANGED (binding)
  refold_target_w72:

    sha256: "7301b6c6924cdfd56b2139d4caf228ae127f061bcf69493fa6f86163d1d49964"
  refold_target_w73:

  canonical_constants:
    path: "computations/_shared/canonical_constants.py"
    sha256: "<computed-at-runtime>"
    # consumed names: S_capture_floor_LRD_classic
  # Route-1 machine-readable data (arXiv ancillary / journal MRT): availability
  # checked at dispatch; if found, its bytes are SHA-pinned at runtime in the

# ---- Conditional blocks ----
fb_pair:
```
